records.suggest: A VAT/NBR official comes in January (for example) then he/she starts inspection but sometimes we see he lefts in 5 months. Next, when new officer comes then we have to pay new VAT/TAX and importantly has to go through new ways to convince him. Needs to decrese/abolish tax/VAT in several levels. Officers come all of a sudden and then provides a notice and we need to pay huge amount of money,,,its create a big burden on our business, we want to pay tax but do not want pay to several govt regulatory instituions and officers. We also see those never pay VAT/TAX always in better position in doing business than compared to us who is always pay taxes
